about:
JDM Seattle Engines & Transmissions operates from Tacoma, Washington, under the legal name JDM Seattle Washington Inc. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The business imports and resells Japanese domestic market (JDM) engines, transmissions, wheels, and OEM parts for Toyota, Subaru, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Acura, and Scion vehicles. Its online catalog lists 148 Toyota, 130 Subaru, 84 Honda, 57 Nissan, 17 Mitsubishi, 4 Acura, 3 Mazda, and 2 Scion applications. Each engine is compression-tested before sale, photographed in inventory, and shipped nationwide via freight. Many listings include a 90-day startup warranty on internal moving parts, though some turbocharged units carry a 30-day warranty.

The company serves automotive repair shops, engine rebuilders, and enthusiasts seeking low-mileage replacement powertrains. Customers receive fitment consultation before purchase to verify compatibility with their specific vehicle application.

The operation distinguishes itself with the tagline "JDM Power. Without the Guesswork," emphasizing real-time inventory visibility, pre-sale compression verification, and expert fitment support to reduce the risk typically associated with imported used engines.
